handover.body: Final cleaning, sign-off, operating instructions. Warranty on concealed works and materials.

pillars.title: Three promises — in the contract, not in promises

about.manifesto: Quantum Form is a team that has been delivering turnkey renovation and construction in Tashkent since 2023. We grew out of a simple observation: in this market, clients are used to renovations slipping, prices creeping, and plans mutating from wall to wall. We decided to build a company that works differently — with a signed deadline, a fixed estimate, and a 3D plan before the first swing of the hammer.

quality.label: Quality
quality.body: We control every key node. From screed and wiring to grout joints and hardware install.

deadline.label: Deadline
deadline.body: The deadline is signed, and we pay for it. Each day of our delay is compensated in the client's favour.

transparency.label: Transparency
transparency.body: Photo report once a week, one single point of contact, itemised specification for every position.

hero.title: Book a free site visit
hero.body: We come to the site, discuss the brief, give a first read on timing and budget. Free, no obligation.
